h1: Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa — the Cha-Am beach resort families keep coming back to
intro: If you want a Cha-Am beachfront stay that costs less than the luxury resorts but still gives you a private beach and a fun pool, Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa is a name families mention often · It's a 4-star boutique beach resort opened in 2008 · 105 rooms from deluxe up to beachfront pool villas · with a waterslide pool, kids' pool, spa and a free shuttle into Hua Hin · It's part of the Springfield group that also runs a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course · From approx. ฿2,800/night · This review is compiled from real guest reviews — both the praise and the honest gripes.

body.html: Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa sits right on Cha-Am beach, on Jumnong-Poomivej Road in Cha-Am district, Phetchaburi · What guests mention most is the quiet, clean private beach in front of the resort, with free beach loungers · The resort is low-rise rather than a tower, so it's an easy walk from your room down to the pool or the sand · The overall feel is calm and unhurried — ideal if you want to escape the crowds and just slow down by the sea.

The rooms get a lot of praise · There are 105 rooms across seven types, from Deluxe (around 44 sqm) and Grand Deluxe to Junior Suite, Springfield Pool Room, Family Suite and large beachfront Pool Villas with a private pool · Many guests say the rooms are bigger than expected and well laid out, with a surprisingly spacious dressing area · Nearly every room has a private balcony, and many face the sea or the pool · It works especially well for families who need the extra space.
"The kids spent the whole day on the waterslide and didn't want to get out of the pool · Spacious room, easy beach access, lovely staff — great value for a family stay."

Facilities are well-rounded for this class of resort · There's an outdoor pool with a waterslide and jacuzzi, a kids' pool, a gym and Life Spa@Sea, which guests praise for the massages · Dining covers three outlets: Gourmet@Sea, the beachside Aqua Bar & Grill@Sea, and Coffee@Sea · The breakfast buffet is frequently mentioned as varied and tasty · There's also a Kids Club and a playground, which makes this a solid pick for multi-generational family trips.

Service is something guests consistently praise · Staff are attentive and warm, and many reviews describe the team going above and beyond on small things · That's a big reason Springfield @ Sea ranks #2 of 73 hotels in Cha-Am on Tripadvisor, around 4.7/5 from over 550 reviews, and scores roughly 9.0–9.3 on booking platforms like Trip.com and Agoda · For a resort at this price point, that's a high and credible set of scores.

One thing people overlook is the free shuttle into Hua Hin town and the night market, plus runs into Cha-Am town on a schedule · That softens the one downside of being toward the quieter end of the beach · And because it's part of the Springfield group, which also owns the Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course, golfers often book a stay-and-play package — a niche draw that the other beachfront resorts in the area don't really offer.

As for the gripes in reviews, most are about upkeep · A few guests found sandy or slightly sticky floors, and some noted cleanliness that wasn't always consistent · Mosquitoes can appear at times since the resort backs onto gardens and the sea, though the resort provides repellent incense · A few reviews also say the in-resort dining choices are thinner than advertised for some meals · None of these break the overall experience, but it's worth knowing so you can plan ahead.

Bottom line for anyone planning a Phetchaburi–Cha-Am trip · Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa is a strong fit for families and couples who want a beachfront resort that's easy on the budget but still delivers a private beach, a fun pool and good service · It's a clear value pick in this stretch, from approx. ฿2,800/night for a deluxe room up to five figures for a beachfront pool villa · If you want a relaxed seaside stay that's gentle on the wallet and great with kids, this is a dependable choice.

honestSummary: Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa is the beach resort for travellers who want a budget-friendly seaside family stay · Its strengths are the quiet private beach, the waterslide pool kids adore, spacious rooms, service good enough to rank near the top of Cha-Am on Tripadvisor, and a free Hua Hin shuttle · The trade-offs are a location toward the quieter end of the beach, upkeep that isn't always consistent, and limited in-resort dining for some meals.
honestChecks: If you want to eat out in Hua Hin town every day — the resort is toward the quieter end of Cha-Am beach and needs a car → use the resort's free scheduled shuttle, or pick a hotel in Cha-Am or Hua Hin town if you'd rather walk out to things
If you're particular about cleanliness details — some reviews found sandy or slightly sticky floors → check the room at check-in and flag housekeeping right away; the team here responds well to this

If golf is your main reason to visit — the Jack Nicklaus course is a separate site from the beach resort → book a combined stay-and-play package through the Springfield group for better rates and a shuttle between the course and the resort

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa, Cha-Am

faq.q: Where is Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It sits right on Cha-Am beach on Jumnong-Poomivej Road, Cha-Am, Phetchaburi · It has a private beach · Mrigadayavan Palace is about 12 minutes away · Hua Hin town is around 25–30 minutes by car · Cha-Am Floating Market is about 10 minutes, and the Jack Nicklaus-designed Springfield golf course about 15 minutes.

faq.q: How much does Springfield @ Sea cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿2,800/night for a Deluxe Room of around 44 sqm · Options range from Grand Deluxe, Junior Suite, Springfield Pool Room and Family Suite up to beachfront Pool Villas (five figures) · Rates vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Springfield @ Sea best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for families with kids and couples who want a budget-friendly beach stay · There's a private beach, a waterslide pool, a kids' pool, a Kids Club and a playground · It suits people who mainly want to relax at the resort, plus golfers who want to play the Jack Nicklaus course run by the same group.

faq.q: What review score does Springfield @ Sea have?
faq.a: It's rated 4.7/5 on Tripadvisor, ranking #2 of 73 hotels in Cha-Am from over 550 reviews · and roughly 9.0–9.3 on booking platforms like Trip.com and Agoda · That's a high, credible score for a resort at this price point.

faq.q: Is it easy to get into Hua Hin town from the resort?
faq.a: There's a free scheduled shuttle into Hua Hin and the night market, plus runs into Cha-Am town · The resort is toward the quieter end of the beach, around 25–30 minutes by car from Hua Hin · If you plan to head out to eat or sightsee, check the shuttle timetable at the front desk in advance.

faq.q: Does Springfield @ Sea have a golf course?
faq.a: The beach resort itself doesn't have a course on site, but it's part of the same group as the Jack Nicklaus-designed Springfield golf course, about 15 minutes' drive away · Golfers usually book a stay-and-play package, which gives better rates and a shuttle between the course and the resort.
